Daniel / Sofia —

Thanks again for your patience while we investigated. Attached is our initial RCA packet (Mercato_RCA_v1.pdf) and the node metrics snapshot (node-metrics-graphs-20261018.png). Summary below.

Executive summary (short):
- Impact window: 2026-10-18 12:30–14:10 UTC.
- Symptom: elevated 5xx errors (~10–15%) and p95 latency increases from 120ms to ~900ms; throughput reduced ~40% on peak paths.
- Root cause: an automated kernel-selection heuristic update (deployed 2026-10-18 11:54 UTC) selected a new optimized kernel path that regressed under MercatoPay’s request length distribution, causing occasional kernel-exec failures and increased resource contention on a subset of GPU nodes.

Corrective actions already taken:
1) Hotfix: rolled back kernel-selection heuristic for MercatoPay model variant at 13:05 UTC (hotfix commit attached: hotfix-commit.diff). This restored stability for most traffic.
2) Capacity: provisioned +2 reserved GPU instances in us-west-2 dedicated pool for MercatoPay at 13:15 UTC to reduce queuing and provide headroom.
3) Routing: temporarily disabled a recent aggressive routing policy that consolidated requests onto fewer nodes (applied at 13:30 UTC).
4) Monitoring: added a short-term alert for kernel-exec-failure rate >0.5% and p95 latency >600ms for the MercatoPay model variant.

Planned follow-up (next 7 days):
- Kernel validation test matrix across MercatoPay production-like traces (Marissa / Aditya) — due 10/21 EOD.
- Autoscaler tuning with headroom targets +20% and staged rollout of kernel heuristic (canary on 10/22) — SRE ticket created.
- Post-mortem readout with execs and shared remediation timeline (Laura to coordinate) — proposed Friday 10/22 at 09:00 PT.

Business ask: we understand the commercial impact and are ready to discuss crediting/contract accommodations after the Friday readout. Karthik will follow up with Procurement and Finance.

Attachments: Mercato_RCA_v1.pdf, node-metrics-graphs-20261018.png, hotfix-commit.diff

If anything in the RCA needs clarification before the readout, let me know and we’ll update immediately.

Thanks,
